verdict.rationale: Jira's marketing docs say it connects engineering, product, and marketing initiatives to coordinate big launches across teams. They also cite a timeline view and company-level progress visibility, which supports the cross-team launch coordination part of the story. However, nothing in the pack documents dependency tracking itself, such as dependency links, blockers, or dependency maps. Missing for 10: explicit cross-team dependency tracking (dependency links or visualization), in-depth docs beyond marketing copy, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
